name: RegionalAR
summary:
RegionalAR brings medical imaging into augmented reality on Meta Quest 3/3s. Designed for clinicians and educators in Regional Anesthesia, it lets you interact with real DICOM CT and MRI scans as 3D holographic volumes in your physical space.
